# AR-RIBATT (شركة الرباط)

> Saudi technology consultancy founded in 2019, delivering digital transformation, AI, cloud and DevOps, cybersecurity, agile transformation, training, and its own AI-powered software products for government and private-sector organizations in Saudi Arabia and the region.

AR-RIBATT (شركة الرباط — "حلول فعالة وناجعة") is a technology consultancy headquartered in Saudi Arabia, with presence in the UAE and the United States. The public site is Arabic-first at https://arribatt.sa/ (RTL) with an English route at https://arribatt.sa/en/. Canonical domain: arribatt.sa. Saudi commercial registration (السجل التجاري): 7053815671.

AR-RIBATT combines strategy consulting with hands-on delivery: it assesses digital maturity, designs roadmaps, implements platforms (cloud, DevOps, Atlassian, security), runs managed 24/7 operations, and trains client teams. It is an equal-opportunity employer operating under the Saudi Labor Law and localization (Saudization) requirements.

## Expertise (خبراتنا)

- Digital transformation and AI (التحول الرقمي والذكاء الاصطناعي): AI adoption roadmaps, prioritization, data and AI platforms, moving from ambition to measurable results
- Cloud and DevOps (الحوسبة السحابية DevOps): seamless cloud migration, CI/CD and automation for faster, more reliable infrastructure
- Agile / organizational transformation (التحول المؤسسي المرن): Agile and Scrum adoption to accelerate delivery and raise team efficiency
- Cybersecurity and data protection (الأمن السيبراني وحماية البيانات): proactive security solutions and round-the-clock monitoring of data and systems

## Services (خدماتنا)

- Consulting: strategy, digital-maturity assessments, roadmaps
- Professional services: systems integration, cloud migration, secure software engineering
- Managed services: 24/7 infrastructure and cybersecurity operations
- Enablement and training: Agile, Scrum, and capability-building workshops

## Products (منتجاتنا)

AR-RIBATT products and the platforms it deploys and supports for clients:

- Kurasa AI — AI tender advisor (مستشار المناقصات الذكي): generates government tender specification documents (كراسات الشروط) and evaluates bids automatically, with 100% data sovereignty inside the Kingdom and compliance with national regulations (DGA, NCA)
- Security Next-Gen — AI-powered cybersecurity (SIEM): advanced analytics, automation, and AI-driven insights to detect and respond to cyber threats
- VCM — Vendor and contract management (إدارة الموردين والعقود): centralizes supplier management and automates contract tracking
- SCM — Support contract management (إدارة عقود الدعم والصيانة): tracks support and maintenance contracts and service levels in one place
- Jira — AI-assisted agile project management (إدارة المشاريع بالذكاء الاصطناعي)
- Jira Service Management — AI-powered IT service management (إدارة الخدمات التقنية)
- Confluence — AI knowledge management and team collaboration (إدارة المعرفة)
- Jira Product Discovery — innovation lifecycle management (إدارة دورة الابتكار): turn early ideas into prioritized projects
- Jira Align — enterprise strategy management (إدارة الاستراتيجية الرقمية): connects business strategy to technical execution
